source: TrustLensAI_TraditionalML_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Traditional ML RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Traditional ML pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance
